blocks.text: Waves ka diffraction obstacles (rukawaton) ke tez kinaron ya corners (konon) ke gird waves ka bend hona (mudna), ya kisi barrier (rukawat) ke aage waves ka phail jana hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab wave kisi barrier ya opening, yani slit (surakh), se guzre jis ka size wave ki wavelength ke qareeb ho. Wavelength jitni lambi, spreading (phailao) utni zyada; aur wavelength chhoti, to spreading kam.

blocks.alt: Rukawat mein ek jaisa gap, do khaake. Baen: qareeb qareeb seedhe wavefronts (chhoti wavelength) gap se guzar kar thora sa phailte hain: Small wavelength, Small diffraction. Daen: door door wavefronts (lambi wavelength) chaure aadhe daire bana kar phailte hain: Large wavelength, Large diffraction.
blocks.caption: Slit se diffraction (PDF page 157): chhoti wavelength, kam diffraction; lambi wavelength, zyada diffraction (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Diffraction har qism ki waves mein dekha ja sakta hai: pani ki waves, sound waves, light waves aur electromagnetic waves.

items: Corners ke peeche ya darwaze ke raaste sound sun lena, chahe sound kahin aur paida hui ho, kyunke sound waves corners ke gird mud jati hain.
Crystals se X-rays ka diffraction, kyunke crystal mein atoms ki regular (baqaida) rows (qataron) ka beech ka faasla X-rays ki wavelength jitna hota hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gap wahi hai, sirf wavelength badli hai. Jitni wavelength gap ke muqable mein lambi, utna wave (lehar) mur kar phailti hai. Isi liye sound (lambi wavelength) darwaze ke gird mur jati hai magar light (bohat chhoti wavelength) nahi.
Diffraction waves ke behaviour (rawayye) ka basic (bunyadi) hissa hai aur different (alag alag) fields (shobon) mein is ki bohat si practical applications hain.
